entry.title: Where the cap is set
entry.summary: The cap is read from the hub, then its section, then the site.
entry.content:
The most specific setting wins:

  1. the hub’s own sidebar_child_cap frontmatter, as on this example’s hub;
  2. sidebar.childCap on the section in docs/_meta/sections.yaml, or in the charter’s sections.entries;
  3. sidebar.childCap in defineDocKittyIntegrations;
  4. the default, 50.

A cap is a positive whole number. Any other value stops the build with a message that names the setting.
